stories.headline: Best thing we can offer young people is a job, not benefits, says chancellor
stories.description: John Healey's speech comes ahead of next month's Budget, as he faces pressure to bring down government borrowing costs.

stories.headline: Ben-Gvir joins hundreds of Israelis to storm Al-Aqsa Mosque compound
stories.description: Israeli national security minister declares ‘we are the owners of the place in Al-Aqsa’ amid heavily guarded incursion.

stories.headline: Cattle to feed: Why a global meat crisis is looming
stories.description: World’s top three beef producers witness a decline in cattle stocks because of rising input costs, droughts and biology.

stories.headline: Iraq looks for oil export alternatives to the troubled Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The continued blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has forced Iraq to look for alternatives to export its oil.

stories.headline: Possible 2028 Democrats swarming South Carolina ahead of midterms
stories.description: Potential 2028 Democratic hopefuls are flocking to South Carolina, the first primary state.
